---
pagetitle: "Global Oil Flows 2026"
description: "Modeled daily crude oil flows from producers through routes to consumers across the 2026 Strait of Hormuz closure."
page-layout: custom
css: web/styles.css
include-after-body:
  text: |
    <script src="web/dist/oil-flows.js"></script>
---

```{=html}
<div class="flows">
  <h1>Global crude oil flows through the 2026 Hormuz closure</h1>
  <p class="sub">Modeled daily flows from producers, through routes, to consumers, in million barrels per day (mb/d) of crude and condensate, January to August 2026.</p>

  <div class="date-row">
    <div class="date" id="date-value"></div>
    <div class="controls" role="group" aria-label="Playback">
      <button id="play" type="button">Pause</button>
      <div class="speed" role="group" aria-label="Playback speed">
        <button type="button" data-ms="200">Slow</button>
        <button type="button" data-ms="100" aria-pressed="true">Medium</button>
        <button type="button" data-ms="50">Fast</button>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <section aria-label="Brent price and Hormuz tanker transits">
    <div class="chart-wrap">
      <div id="price-chart"></div>
      <div class="event-card" id="event-card" role="status" hidden></div>
    </div>
    <input id="scrubber" type="range" min="0" step="1" aria-label="Date" />
  </section>

  <section aria-label="Oil flow Sankey diagram">
    <div class="legend" id="legend"></div>
    <div class="sankey-wrap" id="sankey-wrap">
      <svg id="sankey" role="img" aria-label="Sankey diagram of crude oil from producers through routes to consumers for the selected date. The table below holds the same values."></svg>
      <canvas id="particles" aria-hidden="true"></canvas>
    </div>
  </section>

  <p class="note">These are modeled estimates, not measurements. Apart from cargoes at sea, flows reach consumers the same day they leave. Hover over a stored-oil node for what it means, or see the <a href="methods.html">method and limitations</a>.</p>

  <details id="table-details">
    <summary>Table of values for this date</summary>
    <div class="table-scroll"><table id="values-table"></table></div>
  </details>
</div>
<div class="flow-tip" id="flow-tip" role="status" hidden></div>
```
